correctness.rationale: The 15 nonzero Cayley differences are exhaustively classified with exact third-center coverage in A/B/C classes: none for A or C, exactly two for each difference in B. This proves exactly 32 minimal three-set dominators. All 32 are the triangles of the graph isomorphic under an invertible matrix, and both translated triangle orbits have explicit eight-trace witness tables. The all-positive trace excludes every support not contained in a triangle. The face vector (1,16,48,32), VC=3 and LD=3 follow. The affine quotient of the standard triangular tiling modulo 4 in both directions gives a topological torus, establishing H1=Z^2 and H2=Z integrally. Full 16-bit mask enumeration by separate Python and C++17 scripts agrees with the proof; both were rerun from the packaged source paths.

value.rationale: The full minimum-dominator hypergraph is a natural optimization invariant on a canonical strongly regular graph. Its shattering relation reconstructs an edge-disjoint isomorphic graph, and its complete support complex has a genuine torus fundamental class and rank-two first homology. The result links exact optimization, concept geometry, and integral topology, while giving the first self-contained corrected optimizer census relative to a conflicting accessible 2019 publication. The result is not a mere renaming or a numerical table.
